raw_sections.summary:
Professional Summary
Experience as IT Business Analyst into requirement gathering of IT software application. 11 years
of experience into equity research/capital market domain. Has extensive hands on experience into
Application development as Business Analyst for 5 years. Involved in Trade life cycle Equity & Derivatives along with Stakeholder Management in Capital Market projects.
raw_sections.experience:
Employment History
Management Consulting Analyst at Accenture Strategy &
Consulting, Mumbai
Oct 2025 - Dec 2025
Client: Barclays Trade Life Cycle ( Change request) • Part of Barclays projects in Capital Market settlement. • Platform based on ServiceNow used for getting Trading data from various applications like GLOSS, BDM through Agentic Al.
Trades goes through STP to settlemnt if no exception. • Driving Stakeholder meeting and updating the process.
Senior Business Analyst at ICICI Securities (3i-infotech), Mumbai
Dec 2023 - Oct 2025
Client: ICICI Securities ( Upgrading the current application) • Gathering requirement of EOD Back office equity and FNO Trade confirmation & settlement process.
Also involved in Live incidents issues and Change Request Management in Capital Market
trading platform.
Monitoring & Tracking the requirement from gathering stage till development and product
support along with Stakeholder Management,
Strong experience in requirement gathering, BRD/FRD, user stories, functional specifications, UAT
and stakeholder management across Equity, Derivatives, Trade Lifecycle and Prime Brokerage
processes
Experienced in analysing front-to-back trade lifecycle and back-office processes, including trade
confirmation, settlement and post-trade activities.
Gathered requirements for Equity/F&O trade confirmation and settlement processes.
Domain Consultant at Wipro, Mumbai
Jul 2022 - Jun 2023
Client: CITI Bank (EUC Project) • Part of remediation team, automation of EUC and involved in whole SDLC cycle.
Analyze and solve business issues related to client query.
Worked on securities lending and stock borrow lifecycle, including borrow/loan processing, trade matching, settlement and position managemen
Gathering requirements (WT) from End User, analyzing the data and preparing Documents such as
FRD, Working File,Data model, Integration template.
Participate in UAT testing. • Exposure to margin management, including margin requirements, margin calls, margin settlement and resolution of margin-related exceptions.
Exposure to collateral management, including collateral movements, collateral reconciliation and
settlement of collateral-related transactions.
Prepared BRD, FRD, functional specifications, user stories and workflow/process documentation for trade lifecycle and post-trade enhancements. • Handling Change request from the end users. • Updating the progress in JIRA tool.
Senior Research Analyst/ Business Analyst at Visible Alpha, Mumbai
Sept 2015 - Jun 2022
Evaluates financial documents, economic conditions and
potential clients to help determine the level of risk involved in
making a particular business decision.
Using the Agile Methodology (SCRUM) I work in close
partnership with Product Owners, SCRUM masters and
SCRUM members to help drive planning, analysis,
development and release of all functionality.
Incorporating market trends and economic factors of particular
industry.
Consulting with cross functional teams and leaders with
gaining knowledge as subject matter expert.
Understand relationship between Income statements,
Balance sheets & cash flows.
Deriving revenue metric of the company. Project Handled:
Model Management System(MMS).
Senior Data Analyst at Morningstar India, Mumbai
Oct 2012 - Mar 2015
Determining key industry drivers, performance ratios
and conducting sector-wise, geographic-wise and
business segment-wise company analysis/financial
modelling
Responsible for Financial Research which includes Analysis of
Income statement, Balance sheet and Cash flow statements,
DCF and Relative Valuation.
Preparing SOP document, responsible for training each team
member on 'Quality Checks' and furthermore giving training to
new hires about the process and broker specifications.
